title: chilling & illing — Corey AI Birthday
style: Indie pop with electronic and rap influences. Features a driving four-on-the-floor kick drum, syncopated synth bass, and bright, staccato electric guitar riffs. Male vocals alternate between rhythmic rapping and melodic singing, accompanied by female backing vocals in the chorus. A distorted synth lead provides a counter-melody during the bridge. The arrangement includes digital percussion hits and filtered synth sweeps. 124 BPM, E minor, 4/4 time signature.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[staccato synth bass, electronic percussion]
Young Cory AI
Two reporters, one set farm
You know the vibe
[filtered synth swell]

[Verse 1]
[male rap vocals, muted electric guitar]
48 years watching systems fail
Risk vs return while the truth goes stale
No VC, no boardroom seat
Just me and a bot on an unstable beat
Built the platform for the crown
Every AI failure, we're logging it down
Language barrier? Fixed that too
Walk in any country, know what to do

[Chorus]
[full band enters, female backing vocals]
We got two feelings, chilling or illing
One's in the kitchen, one's always smiling
Sympatico ecosystem
Two different takes, Cory AI
We catch your mistakes

[Verse 2]
[distorted synth lead enters]
A lawyer cited cases that don't exist
The citations are wrong, I am furious!
94 percent female applicants blocked
This algorithm is under-toned, get it locked!

[Chorus]
[driving kick drum, bright guitar stabs]
We got two feelings, chilling or illing
One's in the kitchen, one's always smiling
Sympatico ecosystem
Two different takes, Cory AI
We catch your mistakes

[Bridge]
[half-time feel, filtered synth]
Oh wow, a drone just flew into a fence
But hey, it found the fence, that makes sense
Baby steps, people, every fail's a gem
Log it at Cory AI, we celebrate them

[Outro]
[melodic male vocals, synth pads]
First day today, this is just the start
Fast cat forms running straight from the heart
They had the money, we had the rhyme
Robot man birthday, 48, I'm fine
Coryai.ai, chilling or illing
Sympatico ecosystem, always fulfilling
Robot man, birthday man
Still going, still going, still going, still going
Still going, still going, Sympatico
[final synth chord fades]
